scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Proves the exact labeled equality classification and enumerator for C7 strong C2k at all integers k>=3; makes no claim for odd second-factor lengths, symmetry orbits, or larger products. The complete 2005 Klobucar text could not be inspected, creating bibliographic uncertainty. Finite computer checks corroborate but do not prove the general result. No independent audit was performed.
title: Two structural phases of optimal seven-cycle by even-cycle zero-error codes
